Sam: Heads-up — customer-driven perf planning for next quarter. Customers are pushing hard on latency SLOs; I want to propose a focused sprint: kernel fusions, KV cache prefixing/hot caching, and gated quant profiles. Need alignment on launch criteria and prioritization. Who can join a quick sync?

Anya: +1. Can you surface the top customer asks and we’ll map impact -> priority. I can pull CS notes today.

Marcus: I can own kernel work. Draft tasks: fused attention/matmul, rotary/rope optimizations, mem-compact slow path. T-shirt estimates: S=2w, M=4w, L=8-10w depending on testing. Need clarity on which ops are allowed to be approximate.

Priya: From quant side: two main options — int8 dynamic (safer, good perf) vs 4-bit hybrid (better perf, higher risk). We must run evals on customer prompt sets. Also KV improvements: prefix dedupe + hot-shard in-memory cache yields big p50 wins for chat use-cases.

Liam: Ops note: Reserved capacity + aggressive autoscale gives predictable p99, but customers will expect guarantees. If we promise p50 < X ms we may require dedicated pools for high-SLA customers.

Sam: Example ask: Customer A (Fintech) wants p50 < 30ms for short-context (<=512 tokens) and p99 < 200ms. They said they'd commit to Dedicated if we can hit that. That should bump priority for the kernel+KV combo.

Marcus: If we do fused kernels + int8 fallback path, I estimate ~6w dev + 2w testing. Adding KV prefix/hot cache +2w. We should gate shipping quant until eval harness approves.

Anya: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
```
- perf-regression: no >2% quality drop on eval set (top customer prompts)
- p50 target met in prod canary for short-context profile
- p99 within 1.5x baseline under expected load
- safe fallback paths configured (fp16, int8 fallback)
- telemetry: per-route tokens, cost, latency dashboards live
- rollback plan + canary rollout automation
```

Priya: Agree. For the eval pass we need ~2k real requests sampled across top customers and system prompts. CS can share sanitized traces. Also need AB tests to measure quality delta.

perf-bot: Benchmark cluster booking confirmed — Wed 10:00. Please ensure teams upload artifacts by Tue EOD.

Marcus: I'll put S/M/L estimates in a doc by Mon EOD and schedule a 30m sync Tue 10:00 to lock scope. Can someone own the customer impact matrix?

Anya: I'll own the impact matrix and pull CS notes. @Liam can you confirm pricing incentives (reserved capacity discounts) to push customers to Dedicated?

Liam: Yes — I can draft pricing bands and capacity minimums. Need to know expected commit size to model cost.

Sam: Action items: Marcus=kernel estimates + timeline; Priya=quant eval plan + AB design; Anya=customer impact matrix; Liam=pricing + ops constraints. Sync Tue 10:00 (calendar invite coming). Pinning this thread for agenda. :thumbsup:
